findings.title: Keyboard Refresh removes the focused control and recovery leaves document.body active
findings.observation: The actual Refresh button is focused and activated with Enter. The error control disappears while Refreshing posts is visible; document.activeElement becomes BODY and stays BODY after a new successful cursor chain has rendered. The focused confirmation has 11 distinct retained rows, no remaining changed-feed alert and the same language URL. Its next Tab reaches the first retained author's link (AUDIT D2 A); do not infer that Tab went to global navigation.
findings.expected: A keyboard user who starts recovery retains an intentional focus destination while the control is replaced, and after completion focus is on the recovered list or a suitable actionable descendant.
findings.actual: BODY during the pending state and after completion.
findings.sourceCause: The restarting branch removes FeedFailure and its focused button. A completed restart remounts FeedPages with a new generation key; no focus handoff accompanies either replacement.
minimalReproduction: Start this exact candidate frontend with Task against the retained shared Main.

Open /en?lang=en in an anonymous browser. Intercept only the first /api/main/v1/feed request that contains cursor and return HTTP 409 {code:'cursor_conflict'}; pass every later request to the actual backend.
When the feed-changed alert appears, focus its Refresh button and press Enter once.
Wait for Refreshing posts to appear, then for at least six distinct [data-feed-item] rows and the alert to disappear.
Assert document.activeElement !== document.body. The assertion fails on the reviewed head, after URL, anonymous credentials, unique IDs and successful backend response assertions have passed.
findings.repairDirection: Preserve or transfer focus intentionally when recovery removes the control and when the new generation renders. Retain the fresh chain, busy status, URL/filter and reader-identity guarantees. Add this reached keyboard outcome to the owner's regression coverage.
findings.sourceOnlyRelatedSites: The initial-failure restart branch and New posts generation replacement also replace controls/subtrees. They are class-level source risks, not separately reproduced public failures in this review.
